name: efficiency
wording: The share of effort that goes into work realizing the meaning, measured for every story and task as its agent runs by role, its tokens and its elapsed time, against what its size suggested. A story or task that runs far beyond its size is stopped and reported to the operator rather than pushed on, so effort that does not converge is visible and corrected, not discovered afterwards.
reason: The operator, 2026-10-15: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure; each role is defined by what it receives and hands over, each handover states what it must contain, and established practice is named rather than restated. The operator, 2026-10-15: what is measured includes elapsed time, and work that runs far longer than its size suggests is stopped and reported.
